name: statusline
description: A status line above the prompt, redrawn every 20 seconds: repo and branch, context, cache countdown, 5-hour and weekly quota pace, usage credits, and alerts for a non-default model, an advisor or low effort.

repo.title: Repo and branch
repo.description: The git repo and branch of the session's directory.

context.title: Context
context.description: 🧠 How full the context window is, with its size in tokens.

cache.title: Cache countdown
cache.description: ⏳ Time until the prompt cache goes cold, and 🧊 once it has.

five_hour.title: 5-hour quota
five_hour.description: ⏱️ The 5-hour window, coloured by pace against the time left, with its reset.

seven_day.title: Weekly quota
seven_day.description: 📆 The weekly window, coloured by pace against the time left, with its reset.

credits.title: Usage credits
credits.description: 💵 Usage credits spent against the monthly cap, as /usage shows them. Red while a quota is used up.

model.title: Model
model.description: 🤖 The session's model, in red when it isn't Claude Code's default.

advisor.title: Advisor alert
advisor.description: 🎓 Flags a session running with an advisor.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: 💪 The effort level, highlighted below high.

version.title: Claude Code version
version.description: The running version, and the newer one a restart would pick up.
